title: Pumpkin Spice, Gingham Nice
description: A cozy fall outfit for staying home: a cream sweatshirt with three embroidered pumpkins, orange gingham wide-leg pants, fleece-lined suede clogs, chunky gold knot earrings, thick knit socks and a gold claw clip.
intro: Every fall I end up in the same place: a Saturday at home, pumpkins on the counter, and an outfit that has to survive the dog, the kitchen and a run to the farm stand without me changing. This is that outfit, made cute on purpose. A cream sweatshirt with three tiny embroidered pumpkins, orange gingham pants that look like the inside of a bakery box, and cozy clogs you will not take off until November. Six finds, all on one Amazon list.

sections.heading: The sweatshirt that does the talking
paragraphs: A cream crewneck with three small embroidered pumpkins across the chest and a tiny pumpkin outline on the cuff. It is seasonal without being a costume, which is the whole trick. No glitter, no slogan, just pumpkins sitting where a logo would go.
It comes in several colours. The apricot cream is the one in the photos, and it is the one that looks best next to orange.

sections.heading: Gingham, but make it fall
paragraphs: The ANRABESS gingham pants are wide, soft and pull-on, with a little woven tag at the waistband. They have more than 2,000 ratings and come in about twenty colourways. Orange and white is the fall one. Red and white is your Christmas morning pair, so do yourself a favour and look at both.

sections.heading: Cozy from the ankles down
paragraphs: KIDMI fur-lined suede clogs with a cork footbed and a buckle strap, in brown. They are the cozy clog look without the three-figure price, with more than 1,500 ratings at 4.4 stars.
Under them, thick cream knit boot socks, three pairs to a pack, scrunched at the ankle. Yes, socks with clogs. That is the outfit.

sections.heading: The finishing bits
paragraphs: Chunky gold knot earrings from SHERLOVE, which more than ten thousand people bought last month, and a gold Kitsch open-shape claw clip for the hair-up-and-done part. Two small things that make an at-home outfit look like you meant it.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The six finds are the sweatshirt, the gingham pants, the clogs, the knot earrings, the boot socks and the claw clip. The rug, kitchen, ladder, pumpkins, bread, flowers, copper pans, tumbler and the dog are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
